content.stem: 客户细分对于有效的交易监控很重要,原因在于:

options.A: 所有客户都以相同的方式进行交易，这使得交易模式易于被发现。
options.B: 在相似的同类群体中，客户行为能够得到最有效的比较和分析。
options.C: 它允许将各种各样的客户类型归入一个大组进行比较。
options.D: 监管机构仅出于防范制裁风险的考虑而提出此建议。

content.stem_en: Customer segmentation is important for effective transaction monitoring because:

options_en.A: All customers transact in the same way, allowing patterns to be easily spotted
options_en.B: Customer behavior can be compared and analyzed most effectively among similar peer groups
options_en.C: It allows a broad range of customer types to be compared in one large group
options_en.D: It is recommended by regulators solely to prevent sanctions risk
